papers.summary: Spectral weight decay uses a decoupled nuclear-norm update. In LLaMA pretraining, it lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss; the paper also reports better clean-test accuracy under label noise.
papers.relevance: Directly addresses spectral regularization, training for low-rank compressibility, and noisy-label generalization.

evidence.quote: spectral weight decay lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss.

papers.title: Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights

papers.summary: ORCA applies soft orthogonality regularization early in training, then removes it. The inspected LLaMA experiments report lower final validation loss than Muon at 350M and 1.3B parameters after 100B tokens.
papers.relevance: Tests how temporary spectral shaping affects LLM optimization and weight spectra.

evidence.quote: Compared with Muon, ORCA reduces the final loss by 0.0194 0.0194 at 350M and 0.0244 0.0244 at 1.3B

papers.title: ORCA: The Annealed Spectral Conditioning Optimizer for Faster, Better LLM Training

papers.summary: Analyzes how GD, SignGD, Muon, Shampoo, and K-FAC change singular-mode birth, saturation, and decay in matrix factorization. Experiments include underdetermined linear regression, not LLM training.
papers.relevance: Provides a framework for reasoning about optimizer geometry and spectral bias, with a clear model-to-LLM limitation.

evidence.quote: Exact exponents depend on the aligned reduction, but the resulting qualitative distinctions persist in the more practical underdetermined regression problem.

papers.title: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization

papers.summary: Ori tracks drifting low-rank gradient subspaces during LLM pretraining. At rank 32 in the inspected 1B LLaMA systems comparison, its optimizer-state peak memory is 0.2487 GB versus 0.3385 GB for GaLore; the paper also compares step times and validation perplexity.
papers.relevance: Directly informs low-rank-gradient pretraining and its quality, memory, and time tradeoffs.

evidence.quote: at rank 32, Ori requires only 0.2487 GB, which is 12.1% less than OSD (0.2832 GB) and 26.5% less than GaLore (0.3385 GB).

papers.title: Ori: Drift-Aware Streaming $k$-PCA for Very Low-Rank LLM Training

papers.summary: Monarch–Muon applies matrix-aware optimization to structured weight factors. In a one-H100, microbatch-four systems comparison at the 6.9B dense reference size, peak memory is 52.94 GB versus 68.87 GB for dense Muon, though the representations differ.
papers.relevance: Connects weight structure, Muon optimization, scale, training memory, and step time.

evidence.quote: Training costs on one H100 at microbatch 4, indexed by the dense reference model size. Monarch–Muon uses 4 blocks.

papers.title: Monarch-Muon: Structure-Aware Muon for Fast and Memory-Efficient Pretraining

papers.summary: A module-matched LoRA rank sweep under label noise finds a second descent, but sampled post-peak ranks that retain parameter savings do not match dense fine-tuning risk. The 7B experiment uses paired seeds and adapts the same projection modules.
papers.relevance: Direct evidence on LoRA rank, parameter savings, and noisy-label generalization.

evidence.quote: Every sampled rank, parity included, remains behind dense in all three seeds

papers.title: LoRA's Second Descent Extends Beyond Parameter Parity

papers.summary: Adds an SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank penalty to LoRA fine-tuning. In three-model mixed-domain rank sweeps, the reported penalty lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least 16, while the learning–retention balance remains configuration-dependent.
papers.relevance: Links effective-rank regularization to practical fine-tuning and retention.

evidence.quote: λ = 0.01 lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least 16 16 relative to unpenalized LoRA

papers.title: Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off

papers.summary: Rotated Manifold Optimization accounts for the gauge symmetry of LoRA factors. In the inspected rank-16 Qwen2.5-3B RL comparison, it improves held-out benchmark accuracy over Adam across three runs, with 1.08× per-step time; the RL learning rate was tuned for Adam and reused for RoM.
papers.relevance: Directly addresses LoRA factorization geometry and practical optimization.

evidence.quote: We use the same learning rate for RoM without further tuning.
RoM shows a clearer advantage over Adam in RL finetuning, while requiring only 1.08 × 1.08\times the per-step training time

papers.title: Rotated Manifold Optimization for Low-Rank Adaptation

papers.summary: CORE is a training-free research harness that retrieves passages, returns selected snippets, supports source-context expansion, and suppresses repeated snippets. Its inspected closed-search comparisons report higher answer accuracy and evidence recall than two harness baselines across three agent models and benchmarks.
papers.relevance: Directly applicable to retrieval and context management in a handwritten research-digest harness.

evidence.quote: Across three agent models and three benchmarks, CORE achieves higher answer accuracy and evidence recall than Tongyi DeepResearch and OpenResearcher in every model–benchmark comparison

papers.title: CORE: Coarse-to-Fine Search with Context Management for Deep Research

papers.summary: Idea2Prior combines candidate discovery, identity verification, abstract assessment, citation expansion, and joint ranking. In a small historical retrieval comparison, reported Hit@5 is 16/30 overall, with the advantage concentrated in EASY and MEDIUM queries rather than HARD.
papers.relevance: Informs auditable paper retrieval, ranking, and evaluation for the digest agent.

evidence.quote: The reported aggregate Hit@5 is 16/30 for Idea2Prior, 13/30 for ChatGPT web Deep Research, and 11/30 for Gemini web Deep Research.
The small, overlapping target set and historical protocol do not support a broad or statistically established superiority claim.

papers.title: Idea2Prior: Auditable Paper Retrieval and Ranking from Research Ideas

limitations: Findings are paper-reported; independent replication was not assessed.
Code links mentioned in papers were not verified as complete or runnable implementations.
Monarch–Muon quality and 6.9B systems measurements come from different comparisons; structured and dense representations are not identical.
The CORE and Idea2Prior evaluations concern research or paper retrieval, not this digest harness specifically.
